title: Automate changelog + onboard aurora-lite-3b v1.1 (metadata + perf profiles)
author: Sofia Patel
description: Motivation: onboard aurora-lite-3b v1.1 into the model registry with full metadata, standardized performance profiles, and automated changelog/release notes generation for faster model rollouts. This PR adds a model manifest, perf profile JSON, and wiring for our changelog automation pipeline so future model updates surface release notes automatically. Changes include a new manifest under models/aurora-lite, perf profiles for common seq-len buckets, a small change to the changelog-generator script to consume perf profile diffs, and updated docs. Checklist: - [x] model manifest (metadata) added and validated against schema - [x] performance profiles generated for seq=64/128/512 and validated against perf CI thresholds - [x] changelog automation updated to include perf deltas and metadata changes - [x] docs updated with onboarding steps and changelog format - [x] CI: unit + integration + perf smoke passed Notes: perf deltas are within expected variance; signal tests for P99 latency improved slightly due to kernel selection fallback metadata. Rolling out: model staged to internal catalog flagged as beta, will be promoted to stable after one week of production telemetry. Related: ENG-4821 for onboarding checklist, PM-132 for release coordination.
commits: feat(registry): add models/aurora-lite/manifest.yaml (metadata, tags, model pins)
perf(profiles): add aurora-lite-3b-v1.1 perf profiles for seq64/128/512

docs(model-registry): document onboarding and changelog automation steps
fix(ci): tune perf-smoketest thresholds to match new profile format
